title: Sound Gallery - Bear with cubs (Natural Sounds)
author: National Park Service
changes: Bear cubs (most likely brown bears, Ursus arctos; the NPS page does not name the species) making their mewling, whining calls next to their mother in Denali National Park, Alaska. Trimmed to 0.30–3.20 s of the original, mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 70 Hz, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), peaks limited by 2.0 dB, 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. US National Park Service recording (public domain).
